content.summary: Welcome to your reading lesson on environmental conservation and wildlife protection. In this mission, you will read short passages about everyday eco-habits, learn how to express green actions using modal verbs like can and should, and discover ways to safeguard endangered species.

linguisticTarget.grammar: Modal verbs (can, should) for recommendations and the preposition 'by' followed by gerunds (-ing) to explain methods.

linguisticTarget.readingStrategy: Scanning texts for specific keywords and skimming paragraphs to identify main environmental issues.

learningObjectives: Understand the main idea of short A2 texts about environmental protection.

contextWarmup.prompt: What is one simple habit you can do every day to help reduce plastic waste?
options: Use a reusable water bottle instead of buying single-use plastic bottles.
Throw all plastic bags into the kitchen sink.
Leave electrical appliances plugged in all night.
contextWarmup.explanation: Using a reusable water bottle is an effective eco-habit that directly reduces single-use plastic waste.

rules: Gunakan 'We can/should + verb' untuk memberikan saran lingkungan: We can reduce waste. / We should recycle plastic.
Gunakan 'by + verb-ing' untuk menjelaskan cara: We protect animals by preserving their habitats. / We save energy by turning off lights.
Gunakan present simple untuk fakta lingkungan: Endangered species need protection. / Rainforests produce oxygen. / Plastic waste harms the ocean.

commonTrap.explanation: Learners often add 'to' after modal verbs like 'can' or 'should'. Remember that modals are followed directly by the base verb without 'to'.
commonTrap.wrong: We should to recycle plastic bottles.

content.passageTitle: Our Green Planet: Protecting Nature Together
paragraphs: Earth is our home, and taking care of it is important for everyone. Every day, people produce a lot of waste such as plastic bottles and food packaging. This waste often ends up in rivers and oceans, where it can pollute the water and harm marine animals. To stop this problem, we should reduce our daily waste and recycle as much as possible. Simple habits like bringing cloth bags to the supermarket make a big difference.

Wildlife conservation is another key part of protecting our planet. Many plants and animals face danger because human activities destroy their natural habitats. For example, cutting down trees in tropical rainforests leaves rare animals without a home. Orangutans and tigers are now endangered species. We can help these animals by supporting conservation projects and using renewable energy sources like solar power to protect the environment for future generations.

content.summary: Practical guide on structuring sentences to express environmental suggestions, conservation methods using 'by', and ecological facts in English.

blueprintItems.title: Step 1: Suggesting Eco-Habits
blueprintItems.formula: We + can / should + base verb + object
blueprintItems.example: We should recycle plastic bottles every week.

blueprintItems.title: Step 2: Explaining Methods with 'by'
blueprintItems.example: We save energy by turning off lights when leaving a room.

blueprintItems.title: Step 3: Stating Environmental Facts
blueprintItems.formula: Noun / Uncountable noun + present simple verb + complement

mechanicsRules.rule: Capitalize proper names of geographic regions and natural landmarks.
mechanicsRules.badExample: we must protect the amazon rainforest.
mechanicsRules.goodExample: We must protect the Amazon rainforest.
mechanicsRules.why: Proper names like the Amazon are capitalized in English.

mechanicsRules.rule: Use the gerund form (-ing) after the preposition 'by'.
mechanicsRules.badExample: We save trees by recycle paper.
mechanicsRules.goodExample: We save trees by recycling paper.
mechanicsRules.why: Verbs following prepositions such as 'by' require the -ing suffix.

mechanicsRules.rule: Ensure subject-verb agreement with uncountable environmental nouns.
mechanicsRules.why: Uncountable nouns like 'plastic waste' take singular verb forms in the present simple.
